extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and administrative staff preparing NIH PHS 398 (e.g., R21/R01) grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling required PHS 398 application components (biosketches, specific aims, research strategy, human subjects/HESC declarations, modular budget, personnel justification, and required attachments) for submission to NIH. Includes completing cover page supplements and documenting institutional/IRB/registry items.

rubrics_metrics.name: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH format and length
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES. NAME, POSITION TITLE, eRA COMMONS USER NAME, EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, and include postdoctoral training.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a personal statement (A. Personal Statement) describing relevant experience and fit to the project; B. Positions and Honors; C. Selected Peer-reviewed Publications. Follow the specified format for each person and keep the biosketch within the 4-page limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims section
rubrics_metrics.description: SPECIFIC AIMS — succinctly state hypotheses and the experiments/aims that will test them (numbered Specific Aim 1, Specific Aim 2, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims should state the central hypothesis, describe the planned experiments, and indicate sample sizes/subject sources when relevant (example: 'determine normal range in 200 full-term deliveries'; 'follow 50 infants from birth through 12 months'). Number aims and tie them directly to hypotheses and anticipated outcomes/impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy — Significance
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH STRATEGY (a) SIGNIFICANCE — Describe the importance of the problem, the gap in knowledge, why the research matters, and the potential public health impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the project addresses an important problem, cite preliminary data as justification, quantify public health burden if appropriate, and connect findings to potential improvements in prevention/treatment or scientific understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy — Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH STRATEGY (b) INNOVATION — Describe how the proposed work differs from prior studies and why it is novel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight novel concepts, approaches, or models and explain how the project challenges current paradigms or introduces new methodologies relative to existing literature.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Research Plan: Specific required attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: List of Research Plan Attachments enumerating required sections to be attached to the Research Plan (e.g., Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Protection of Human Subjects, Inclusion of Women and Minorities, Targeted/Planned Enrollment Table, Inclusion of Children, Vertebrate Animals, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Letters of Support, Resource Sharing Plan(s), Appendix, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the applicable sections of the research plan and supporting documents as listed. Use the exact attachments and order requested by the form; include special items for resubmission or revision (Introduction to Application) when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Protection of Human Subjects — include the human subjects protection section in the Research Plan attachments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe protections, risks, risk mitigation, consent procedures, and oversight. Cite IRB approval status or plans to obtain approval. If an existing approved protocol is used, reference the approving committee (example in text: UCSF Committee on Human Research).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of Women and Minorities — include a section addressing plans for inclusion across sex/gender and racial/ethnic groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide justification for subject selection, recruitment strategies, and analysis plans for subgroup inclusion as required by NIH policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted/Planned Enrollment Table
rubrics_metrics.description: Targeted/Planned Enrollment Table — provide a table showing planned enrollment by sex/gender, race/ethnicity, and other relevant categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the enrollment table with expected numbers and timelines; align with Human Subjects sections and inclusion plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of Children — include a section that addresses inclusion (or exclusion) of children and justifies the plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether children are included, the age ranges, and provide appropriate protections/consent processes or rationale for exclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals
rubrics_metrics.description: Vertebrate Animals — include a vertebrate animals section if the project uses animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe species, justification, use, care, and oversight (IACUC approvals or plans to obtain them).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements — include information on collaborations, consortium roles, and contractual agreements as part of the Research Plan attachments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide letters/agreements that specify responsibilities, resource sharing, and budgetary/administrative relationships between institutions or contractors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters of Support — provide letters documenting institutional and collaborator commitments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach formal letters that confirm availability of resources, key personnel commitments, and collaborations described in the proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource Sharing Plan(s) — include plans for sharing data, model organisms, tools, or other resources resulting from the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how and when data/resources will be shared, repositories to be used, and any restrictions; attach formal plans as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix — include allowable supplementary material in the Appendix section per PHS 398 guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach only materials permitted by NIH appendix rules and follow format/size restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Application (resubmission or revision only)
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction to Application — required for RESUBMISSION or REVISION only; attach an Introduction describing changes made in response to prior review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize prior review critiques and list specific revisions in the application; include introduction as a separate attachment when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report Publication List
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress Report Publication List — attach a list of publications resulting from prior support or progress reports as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include relevant publications that demonstrate productivity or progress on related work; attach under Research Plan attachments when requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Select Agent Research — include section(s) related to select agent use if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide required approvals, biosafety plans, and inventories for work involving select agents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan — include a leadership plan if the application designates multiple PD/PIs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe roles, decision-making processes, administrative responsibilities, and communication plans among multiple PIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — PD/PI contact and clinical trial flags
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement contains PD/PI name and contact fields and requires answers to Human Subjects/Clinical Trial questions (e.g., Human Subjects? Clinical Trial? Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial?).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete PD/PI identifying information (name, title, address, contact). Explicitly indicate whether the project involves human subjects, whether it is a clinical trial, and whether it is an Agency-defined Phase III clinical trial.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (HESC) reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Embryonic Stem Cells — 'Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells?' If yes, list registration numbers of specific cell lines from the NIH registry or check that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the exact registry numbers when available; if not, check the box indicating a registry-registered line will be used. Follow NIH stem cell policy and registry requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modular Budget fields and format
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Modular Budget — provide start/end dates and for each budget period specify Direct Costs less Consortium F&A, Direct Costs, Indirect Costs, Consortium F&A, Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), Funds Requested ($), Cognizant Agency and contact, Indirect Cost Rate Agreement Date, Total Indirect Costs, and Total Direct and Indirect Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete modular budget tables for each budget period (Periods 1–5 and cumulative). Attach Budget Justification documents (Personnel Justification, Consortium Justification, Additional Narrative Justification) and relevant files. Follow NIH modular budget conventions and indirect cost rate agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: PERSONNEL JUSTIFICATION — list each key person with name, role/title, calendar months of effort (e.g., 'will devote 0.60 calendar months'), and a narrative of qualifications and responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concise descriptions of each person's expertise, how their effort supports the project, and specific tasks they will perform (sample acquisition, laboratory analyses, data management, oversight). Use examples to quantify effort and responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Narrative/Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: ADDITIONAL NARRATIVE JUSTIFICATION — explain the rationale for budget allocations across years and any nonstandard resource needs (example: budget more resources in FY01 to complete Aims 1 and 2; cost $25,000 or one additional module).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Justify timing of expenditures, personnel effort allocation across project years, and any one-time costs. Attach additional narrative and justify modular budget choices.
